say:4:1320803003:0.text: So what if there is magic? Magic can't bypass our rules and regulations!
say:4:1320803003:0.source_cn: 魔法又如何，魔法也不能破坏我们的规则制度！
say:4:1320803003:0.male: So what if there is magic? Magic can't bypass our rules and regulations!
say:4:1320803003:0.female: So what if there is magic? Magic can't bypass our rules and regulations!

say:6:1320803004:1.text: There's no need to be such a stickler for the rules... Since the job is done, can you just fill in what happened on the official record?
say:6:1320803004:1.source_cn: 各位，我想也许没必要这么死板……既然工作已经完成，只要...

say:9:1320803006:1.text: Listen, we have our own regulations. Slips in the process are way more embarrassing than leaving a job or two unfinished!
say:9:1320803006:1.source_cn: 我们有自己的规矩，流程上的疏漏可远比完不成一两件工作的...

say:10:1320803007:1.text: Oh, really? The dwarves I know aren't as inflexible as you are.
say:10:1320803007:1.source_cn: 哦，是吗？我认识的矮人可不全像你们这样死板。

say:11:1320803008:1.text: Is that so? Have you met any dwarves like that, Tory?

say:13:1320803009:1.text: Nope! That's like saying people don't like spiced goat milk!
say:13:1320803009:1.source_cn: 没有！我倒是见过不爱喝羊奶的。

say:14:1320803010:1.text: It's true! We know a dwarf named Hugin. He loves inventing new things and doesn't care much for keeping to some old rules and doing the same things over and over.
say:14:1320803010:1.source_cn: 是真的呢，他叫呼金！他最喜欢做的事就是不断发明新东西，...

say:15:1320803011:1.text: Wait... did you just say Hugin?

say:16:1320803012:1.text: Do you mean Hugin the Master Planner?
say:16:1320803012:1.source_cn: 你说那个呼金？“规划师”呼金？

say:18:1320803013:1.text: No way! This whole production line was planned by him!
say:18:1320803013:1.source_cn: 哈，这绝不可能！因为这个计划就是他制定的！

choice_prompt:19:1320803013.text: No way! This whole production line was planned by him!
choice_prompt:19:1320803013.source_cn: 哈，这绝不可能！因为这个计划就是他制定的！

say:20:1320803014:1.text: Of course! Everyone from senior engineers to junior apprentices know of Hugin! He even made the designs for the neighborhood we live in.
say:20:1320803014:1.source_cn: 当然，从高级工程师到这里的学徒都知道他。他还亲自给我们...

say:21:1320803015:1.text: Are you saying that this whole set of procedures was formulated by Hugin?
say:21:1320803015:1.source_cn: 唔，你们说，这一整套足可以吓死人的流程……是呼金制定的？

say:22:1320803016:1.text: Yeah, we wouldn't lie about something like this.

say:23:1320803017:1.text: Okay, don't move. Let's have all the work stop for now. We'll go find Hugin and get some answers.
say:23:1320803017:1.source_cn: 你们……你们先不要动，就当停工，我们去找呼金问个清楚。

say:25:1320803018:1.text: Well, if it's an order for work stoppage, there needs to be a formal notice signed by both the construction team leader and a safety inspector.
say:25:1320803018:1.source_cn: 停工要有正式的书面通知，而且需要施工队长和安检员签字说明——

say:26:1320803019:1.text: Alright, got it. We'll go find Hugin first. You guys can...
say:26:1320803019:1.source_cn: 知道了，我们先去找呼金聊聊，你们，呃……

say:27:1320803020:1.text: ...just do something that follows the official procedures.
say:27:1320803020:1.source_cn: 随便做点什么“合乎流程”的事好了！

say:28:1320803021:1.text: You don't need to tell us that. We just want to do a good job without disrupting the process, you know. However, if something unexpected happens, it's gotta be resolved.
say:28:1320803021:1.source_cn: 那当然，工作是第一位的！大家都希望不破坏流程的前提干好...

say:30:1320803022:1.text: Thanks for the help. Say hello to Hugin for us!
say:30:1320803022:1.source_cn: 那就有劳了，代我们向呼金问好！

choice:19:1:2.text: That's a heck of a title.
choice:19:1:2.male: That's a heck of a title.
choice:19:1:2.female: That's a heck of a title.

choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 确实是你们做完的，我可以保证
choice:3:1:2.male: You did the work. I know you did.
